Open-collector output goes low while the LED current exceeds 5 mA; VE low disables the output (left open it is enabled). Propagation delay is not simulated. DIP-8: 2 A, 3 K, 5 GND, 6 VO, 7 VE, 8 VCC.
Totem-pole output swings to VCC while the LED current is above 5 mA and to GND below it (about 5 ohm high, 2 ohm low). 10-35 V supply. DIP-8: 2 A, 3 K, 5 GND, 6 and 7 VO, 8 VCC.
Totem-pole output: VCC while the LED current is above 5 mA, GND below it (about 8 ohm high, 4 ohm low). DIP-8: 2 A, 3 K, 5 GND, 6 and 7 VO, 8 VCC.
